title: Raft
provenance: Reported by Red-Pathfinder (highball-db#468, 2026-10-13), Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXMT, rated 3 of 5 after 6 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M5 on DXMT. Playing online with Windows players worked only after installing the game's 1.09_precrossplayupdate branch from its Steam properties and turning off Limit IP Address Tracking in the Mac's Wi-Fi settings.

knownIssues.symptom: Multiplayer with Windows players does not connect
knownIssues.fix: in Steam choose the game's 1.09_precrossplayupdate branch under Properties, Betas, and turn off Limit IP Address Tracking in the Mac's Wi-Fi settings, as the player did
